name: Glass office tower (abandoned)
description: Abandoned and overgrown: Slim seven-storey office tower on a 14 x 14 m plan, wrapped in a dark-framed glass curtain wall with aluminium fins and slab-edge bands. Glass entrance lobby with reception; six office floors (an open-plan floor behind, a cellular office in front) round a core of stairs, lift and toilets; a stair rising to a roof door, a parapet with a metal coping, rooftop air-handling units in a louvred screen and a water tank.
